_note: Display names for the handful of blocks and items that have no .name entry in lang/en_US.lang, so gamedata.py has nothing to read. Keyed by numeric id. These are the names the game and its community use for them.
_splitNote: The same file also splits names the game shares. A display name is the wiki's identity for a thing -- its page, its sprite, its slot in a recipe -- so two ids that answer to one name become one page, which is right for the two halves of a door and wrong for two different things. gamedata.py lists every shared name when it runs; the ones split here are the ones that were two things.
_variantNote: Names for metadata values en_US.lang has no key for. Block 31 is one id holding three plants -- a dead shrub, tall grass and a fern -- and the game never names any of them.
